## Professional summary

His work focuses on full-stack software development, backend systems, and applied artificial intelligence and machine learning. He is interested in software development, software engineering, AI engineering, and integration engineering opportunities.

## Selected projects

### Deptic

Status: completed/publicly available.

Deptic is a full-stack platform for scanning GitHub repository dependencies, detecting known vulnerabilities, generating security-fix pull requests, exporting CycloneDX and SPDX software bills of materials, and reporting compliance status. Bala's documented role is full-stack developer. The implementation uses Go, Fiber, PostgreSQL, Redis, React, TypeScript, Docker, JWT authentication, the GitHub API, OSV.dev, and NVD data.

- Live application: https://deptic.netlify.app/
- Source repository: https://github.com/BALASANJEEV1085/deptic

### Sentiment Analysis Dashboard

Status: completed project.

A Python dashboard that analyzes sentiment across datasets and presents the results in a unified interface. Documented technologies include Python, Flask, Streamlit, and VADER.

- Source repository: https://github.com/BALASANJEEV1085/Sentiment_analysis_sih

### SocialPlanet

Status: completed/publicly available.

A responsive full-stack social application with posting, liking, and commenting features. Documented technologies include React, MongoDB, Node.js, and Express.js.

- Live application: https://socialsplanet.netlify.app/

### Nandha Notes

Status: completed/publicly available.

A study-material sharing platform for college students with authentication and content-management features. Bala's portfolio identifies him as team leader. Documented technologies include React, MongoDB, Node.js, Express, and Tailwind CSS.

- Live application: https://nandha-notes.netlify.app/
- Source repository: https://github.com/BALASANJEEV1085/NANDHANOTES

### Silkworm Classification

Status: in progress.

A YOLOv8-based computer-vision project intended to classify silkworms as healthy or affected by grasserie. Documented technologies include Python, YOLOv8, PyTorch, and computer vision.

- GitHub profile: https://github.com/BALASANJEEV1085
